title: Walking man
summary: “Walking man: se hace camino al andar” makes reference to time passing by. It’s a tribute to the cinema technology. A man walking in an eternal loop based in 12 images (12 months) that compose a digital personage walking in a zoetrope animated way.

blocks.html: “Walking man: se hace camino al andar” makes reference to time passing by. It’s a tribute to the cinema technology. A man walking in an eternal loop based in 12 images (12 months) that compose a digital personage walking in a zoetrope animated way.
Coded for the Medialab-Prado‘s digital facade, 15 meters wide, as a generative sketch based on Processing.js and showcased as part of AfterArco activities program.
